master_field_note: The historical master alias remains HODL for provenance. required_references is authoritative: all four raw art PNGs are mandatory style inputs. Framed card and SVG entries are historical records, not replacements for art.
selection_scope: Add the exact approved CryptoPunks 038 and corrected CryptoKitties 046 raw illustrations alongside the retained HODL 021 and Birth of Doge 020 style references.
comparison_priorities: Mature anime/manhwa drawing and strong silhouettes
One coherent drawing treatment across people, creatures, props and the entire background
Cinematic, motivated lighting and controlled highlight contrast
Selective material texture without photographic or glossy 3D drift
Consistent background perspective, scale and atmospheric depth
Target-event subjects, palette and evidence remain independent of style references
motif_rule: Do not transplant reference characters, cats, dogs, pixel portraits, logos, symbols, labels, props or scenes into an unrelated event. An intentional cross-card object needs its own documented relevance and approval.
rights_note: Style-reference selection is not copyright, trademark, character, likeness or commercial-reproduction clearance. Underlying characters, logos and motifs retain their separate rights status.
